measures.title: Update of Measure A (1986) to cover deep-sea mining onshore facilities
measures.summary: Amends the county code chapter that voters adopted as Measure A in 1986, which requires voter approval for land use changes for onshore facilities that support offshore oil and gas development. The update would also require voter approval for onshore facilities related to deep-sea mining, add purpose, findings and definitions sections, create an exemption for certain projects, and make other changes the county says are meant to strengthen the law.
measures.yesMeans: The county code is amended to also require voter approval for onshore facilities supporting deep-sea mining, along with the other listed changes.
measures.noMeans: The 1986 Measure A rules stay as they are.

measures.title: County of Santa Cruz temporary half-cent general sales tax
measures.summary: Adds a one-half percent general sales (transactions and use) tax throughout Santa Cruz County, including the cities, for five years, from April 1, 2027 through April 1, 2032. The county estimates about $27,000,000 a year, placed in the General Fund for any lawful purpose; the ballot question lists keeping hospitals and emergency rooms open, ambulance response, urgent and mental health care, and food and housing assistance.
measures.yesMeans: The county adds a half-cent sales tax for five years.
measures.noMeans: The half-cent sales tax is not added.
